title: Asvin Small Dog Bed for Small Dogs, Cat Beds for Indoor Cats, Pet Bed for Puppy and Kitty, Extra Soft & Machine Washable with Anti-Slip & Water-Resistant Oxford Bottom, Grey, 20 inches
features: Soft and comfortable: the bed is made from soft Sherpa fleece, ensuring your furry friend is surrounded by softness. Your pet will be free to walk on it, lie down and fall in love. It can help your pet calm down faster and get a restful sleep.

Unique Design: Our pet bed can not only provide a soft and comfortable bed, but also become your lovely home decoration. The round design creates a sense of security and provides head and neck support.
NON-SLIP BOTTOM - Oxford flat bottom keeps the bed in place on smooth surfaces no matter how much your pet moves.
MACHINE WASHABLE - Easy wash and care, wash the whole bed on gentle cycle in cold water and tumble dry on low.
Size Chart: The 50.8 cm pet bed mat is recommended for small and medium-sized dogs or cats of all ages. Please measure your pet to make sure the size is accurate.
